recommendation: Keep this audit commit. Any future expansion of the note extension to PlanDefinition sub-elements or Element generally should be raised in the FHIR Extension Pack and should explicitly account for FHIR-44919's rejection of Element context.
issue_request: FHIR-18195 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking whether a generic annotation extension should exist for Element; the voted resolution was to remove the current annotation/comment extensions and define a generic note annotation extension with broad context.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied in b3409464ad883b2120e929c03620eefe68d374c9, which rationalized the event, QuestionnaireResponse, StructureDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet extension spreadsheets. Current core source no longer contains event-note, questionnaireresponse-note, structuredefinition-annotation, codesystem-comment, or valueset-comment.
additional_context: FHIR core later removed extension definitions from R5 source. The current StructureDefinition/note source is in the read-only FHIR Extension Pack checkout and is governed by later Published FHIR-extensions issues: FHIR-44380 added the generic Note extension, FHIR-44919 added Composition.section and explicitly said not to set context to Element, and FHIR-32915 added Observation.component.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing or broadening a core Element/Any-context note extension would conflict with later Extension Pack decisions, and no current core build-scoped source contains the stale old extensions.
